description.zh:
设置实例自动续费周期，单位为月。 >
  • 自动续费周期默认值为0，表示实例到期后不自动续费。
  • 例如自动续费周期设置为2，表示实例到期后自动续费2个月。
description.en:
The auto-renewal period of the instance. Unit: months. >
  • The default value of the auto-renewal period is 0, which indicates that the instance is not automatically renewed after the instance expires.
  • For example, if the auto-renewal period is set to 2, the instance is automatically renewed for two months after the instance expires.

description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length and cannot contain non-ASCII characters.

description.zh: 这个参数是为了区分创建的来源，公有云默认为空，可不填写。
description.en: The parameter that identifies the source of the creation request. For public cloud, leave this parameter empty.

description.zh:
实例的磁盘类型，取值：

- **cloud_efficiency**：高效云盘。
- **cloud_ssd**：SSD云盘。
- **local_hdd_pro**：本地HDD盘。
- **local_ssd_pro**：本地SSD盘。
- **cloud_essd_pl1**：ESSD云盘。
description.en:
The disk type of the instance. Valid values:

- **cloud_efficiency**: ultra cloud disk.
- **cloud_ssd**: standard SSD.
- **local_hdd_pro**: local HDD.
- **local_ssd_pro**: local SSD.
- **cloud_essd_pl1**: ESSD.

description.zh: HBase Serverless实例的引擎类型。取值：**serverlesshbase**。
description.en: The engine type of the HBase Serverless instance. Set the value to **serverlesshbase**.

description.zh:
实例的付费类型，取值：

- **Prepaid**：包年包月（预付费）。
- **Postpaid**：按量付费（后付费）。
description.en:
The billing method of the instance. Valid values:

- **Prepaid**: subscription.
- **Postpaid**: pay-as-you-go.

description.zh:
包年包月实例的购买时长，取值：

- 当PeriodUnit为year时，取值范围为**1**~**3**。
- 当PeriodUnit为month时，取值范围为**1**~**9**。

> 仅当实例的付费类型为**Prepaid**时，需要填写此参数。
description.en:
The subscription duration of the subscription instance. Valid values:

- If PeriodUnit is set to year, valid values are **1** to **3**.
- If PeriodUnit is set to month, valid values are **1** to **9**.

> This parameter is required only when the billing method of the instance is **Prepaid**.

description.zh:
包年包月实例的购买单位，取值：

- **year**：年。
- **month**：月。

> 仅当实例的付费类型为**Prepaid**时，需要填写此参数。
description.en:
The unit of the subscription duration for the subscription instance. Valid values:

- **year**: year.
- **month**: month.

> This parameter is required only when the billing method of the instance is **Prepaid**.

description.zh: 实例所属的地域ID，可调用[DescribeRegions](~~144489~~)接口获取。
description.en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~144489~~) operation to query the region ID.

description.zh: 资源组ID。资源组详情请参见[查看资源组基本信息](~~151181~~)。
description.en: The resource group ID. For more information about resource groups, see [View basic information of a resource group](~~151181~~).
The processing capability per unit. Unit: CU.
The specification type. Valid values: leave empty or **serverless.small**.

description.zh: 专有网络下的虚拟交换机ID。
description.en: The vSwitch ID within the VPC.

description.zh:
专有网络ID。

> 本参数与VswitchId参数同时为空时表示实例的网络类型为经典网络。
description.en:
The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC).

> If both this parameter and the VswitchId parameter are left empty, the network type of the instance is classic network.
The zone ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~144489~~) operation to query the zone ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun hbase create-serverless-cluster --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-f --cluster-name serverless-name --vpc-id vpc-bp120k6ixs4eog0000 --vswitch-id vsw-bp191ipotqj1ssyl00000 --pay-type Prepaid --period-unit month --period 6 --auto-renew-period 2 --serverless-spec serverless.small --serverless-capability 1000 --serverless-storage 100 --engine serverlesshbase --engine-version 2.0 --client-token ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz0000 --client-type xx --resource-group-id rg-j4d53glb30000 --disk-type cloud_ssd --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun hbase CreateServerlessCluster --region cn-hangzhou --AutoRenewPeriod 2 --ServerlessStorage 100 --ClientType xx --EngineVersion '2.0' --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-f' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-j4d53glb30000' --VSwitchId 'vsw-bp191ipotqj1ssyl00000' --Period 6 --ServerlessCapability 1000 --PayType Prepaid --DiskType cloud_ssd --VpcId 'vpc-bp120k6ixs4eog0000' --ServerlessSpec 'serverless.small' --ClusterName 'serverless-name' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCz0000 --Engine serverlesshbase --PeriodUnit month
